lines.text: So are we doing Sunday at our place or Joyce's this year?
Ours has the bigger table now, so ours.
Fine by me, less cooking for once.
Sunday at one, everyone brings a side like always.
I'll do the green beans, not the turkey again.
Remember the turkey incident of 2019, still not over it.
Don't remind me, the smoke alarm went off for twenty minutes.
We still call it the fire drill Thanksgiving.
Okay, focus, who's bringing dessert.
I can do pie if someone else does the whipped cream.
I'll grab it from the store, don't have time to make it.
That works. What time should we tell everyone.
One o'clock, so people aren't late for once.
Good luck with that, we're never on time.
Bera, are you coming Sunday?
You better, you missed the last two.
We'll save you a plate either way.
Great, one o'clock then, same as always.
I'll text the group chat so nobody forgets.
Please, last time half the family showed up at three.
Alright, Sunday, one o'clock, sides and dessert sorted.
Sounds good, see everyone then.
